The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid my private value, which is $25. This strategy maximizes expected profit because it balances the chance of winning the auction with the cost of winning. Bidding higher than $25 risks paying more than the item's value, while bidding lower reduces the chance of winning when it would be profitable.
